ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, authorized signatories, and counterparties against the PEP list maintained by the Royal Oman Police and Financial Intelligence Unit, the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, UK/EU sanctions, terrorist designations under Omani law, and other commercial watchlists; Enhanced Due Diligence is mandatory for any PEP, for high-risk-country exposure, and for event-triggered ownership changes; screening must be repeated at least every 90 days during the incorporation process and thereafter on a rolling basis.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion official company and trade name registry — 'Invest Easy' platform (https://investeasy.gov.om) and the Commercial Registration Directorate of MOCIIP
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All Omani companies must have an Arabic trade name; the English name or transliteration must be a faithful phonetic equivalent approved by MOCIIP; the name must not violate public order, religious norms, or commercial reputation; numerals and special characters are generally not permitted except with justified business reasons; the legal-form suffix must reflect the SPC entity type.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reserved trade name may be re-reserved before expiry if the name is still available and incorporation has not been completed; if the trade name is rejected, the applicant must file a written appeal with the Commercial Registration and Licensing Directorate of MOCIIP within fifteen working days of rejection, outlining the grounds and attaching the rejection notice; the Directorate shall issue a reasoned decision within fourteen days. If the rejection is sustained, the applicant may seek administrative review by the Undersecretary for Commercial Registration and thereafter appeal to the competent Administrative Court in Muscat.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered physical office in the Sultanate of Oman is mandatory under the Commercial Companies Law. For the licensed trade-finance and accounts-receivable-factoring activity, a virtual office is not permissible as a principal place of business; a tangible commercial office with physical records and operational personnel is required by MOCIIP and the Central Bank of Oman before the operating license is issued. A virtual address may be used only for pre-registration correspondence until a physical tenancy agreement is executed.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 85% probability of unannounced regulatory inspection by the Central Bank of Oman and Royal Oman Police AML auditors within the first 18 months after licensing commencement; approximately 40% probability of a pre-incorporation physical-substance and premises inspection by MOCIIP during the licensing evaluation stage.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Oman Commercial Companies Law, Sultani Decree No. 18/2019 as amended by Sultani Decree No. 111/2020, Articles 2, 64-71 (Single Person Company) and 228-235 (memorandum and articles); Foreign Capital Investment Law, Sultani Decree No. 50/2019
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP), Companies Registry, one-stop shop via Invest Easy e-portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (MAA) filed electronically with MCIIP; final incorporation evidenced by Commercial Registration (CR) Certificate and SPC Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for single person company formation under Sultani Decree 18/2019; capital is fixed in the Articles and must be deposited in an Omani bank, with a bank deposit certificate submitted before CR issuance. No escrow requirement unless imposed by sector regulator; Central Bank of Oman may require a higher capital floor for factoring license approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The offer and subscription by the sole shareholder to take the entire issued share capital, as stated in the Articles, is approved and the Directors are authorized to allot 2,500 ordinary shares at OMR 1 each. (2) The registered office at [address], Muscat, Sultanate of Oman is adopted as the legal seat. (3) [Name] is appointed as Director/Board Member, [Name] as Corporate Secretary, and [Name] as Financial Officer. (4) Those officers are jointly or singly authorized to execute and submit all statutory filings, open the corporate bank account, obtain the factoring license, and sign the civil defense and municipal permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Legal Entity Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online reservation request via Invest Easy with three proposed company names in English and Arabic, ensuring compliance with Article 31 of SDL 18/2019 (no identical, misleading or prohibited names). Upon approval, obtain a name reservation certificate valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Short description of factoring / receivables purchase trade finance activity (ISIC 6492)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file an administrative objection with MCIIP or resubmit with alternative names; first resubmission is processed without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public attached to MCIIP; licensed Omani attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the MAA under SDL 18/2019 with SPC-specific clauses: single shareholder, one or more managers, registered office, and object clause covering receivable purchase, factoring, reverse factoring and related trade finance services. Arrange notarization before a certified notary; Arabic original takes precedence over any English translation.
required_dossiers: Passport and valid resident visa copy of sole shareholder
Lease agreement or title deed for the proposed registered office
Draft MAA in Arabic and English
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is refused, correct the identified Articles and resubmit; no new name certificate is required unless the company name is also changed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration and Single Person Company Incorporation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIIP, Companies Registry, Invest Easy one-stop-shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized MAA, lease proof, bank capital deposit certificate and completed SPC application. MCIIP screens the dossier and issues the Commercial Registration (CR) Certificate and the SPC Certificate of Incorporation. The company attains legal personality on the date of issuance.
required_dossiers: Registered office lease and landlord consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MCIIP queries the address or capital, remedy by submitting landlord title certificate, updated lease, or a revised bank certificate within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Chamber of Commerce Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority; Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register for corporate income tax at the Oman Tax Authority and obtain a Tax Card. Enroll with the Oman Chamber of Commerce for mandatory commercial membership linked to the CR. File a VAT registration application if annual taxable supplies exceed the voluntary threshold, and apply for any relevant classification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Tax Card or Chamber certificate is delayed, submit the attested CR and a shareholder undertaking to the One-Stop-Shop; escalate through the Tax Authority’s taxpayer service for resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Central Bank of Oman Factoring License – Sector Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Bank of Oman, Non-Banking Financial Institutions Supervision Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a detailed licensing application under the applicable non-banking financial institution framework. Provide corporate constitutional documents, a five-year business plan, compliance manual, comprehensive AML/CFT policy, paid-up capital evidence, and fit-and-proper information for shareholders and senior management. Obtain a decision before commencing factoring operations.
required_dossiers: Shareholder and senior management fit-and-proper declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CBO issues a query or deficiency letter, respond with supplementary documentation within 30 days; if the license is rejected, remedy the gaps and reapply or hold a pre-application consultation session.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal and Civil Defense Physical Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality; Royal Oman Police Directorate General of Civil Defense
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to Muscat Municipality for land-use classification and commercial occupancy approval for the registered office, including building safety clearance. Simultaneously apply to the Civil Defense for a Fire and Life Safety Certificate after physical inspection of egress, fire extinguishers, alarm systems and emergency signage. Obtain a workplace occupational safety clearance if required under Oman labour regulations.
required_dossiers: Fire extinguisher and emergency equipment service certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inspection identifies deficiencies, complete remedial works and apply for re-inspection; for municipal refusal, file an appeal within 15 days of written rejection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Central Bank of Oman – Non-Banking Financial Institutions Supervision Department; MCIIP for commercial registration and factoring licence classification
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Non-Banking Financial Institution License for Factoring and Receivables Purchase; Commercial Registration (CR) for trade and supply chain finance activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority (formerly Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 – Low-risk office-based activity: registration sufficient; no full Environmental Impact Assessment study or EIA report required for a factoring company
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process, wastewater or VOC emission generated. Office refuse must be segregated and collected through municipal waste services. Electronic waste disposed in compliance with Executive Regulation 79/2020. If a standby generator is installed, diesel exhaust must meet Omani Standard OS 8 (2003) for air emissions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire and Life Safety Certificate issued under Royal Oman Police Civil Defense Law RD 49/2012; building structural safety clearance from Muscat Municipality; workplace registration with the Ministry of Labour, including compliance with OSH framework per OS 420/2015.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), Sultanate of Oman – official e-portal: https://taxoman.gov.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) must obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT Registration Number from the Oman Tax Authority through the Taxoman e-Services portal. The SPC must first be incorporated with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) and obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate. Following incorporation, the company must apply online for Corporate Income Tax (CIT) registration via Taxoman, submitting the CR certificate, constitutional documents (Articles of Association / SPC contract), residency and identity documents of the director and ultimate beneficial owners, and a valid local address. For VAT purposes, the SPC must complete a separate VAT registration application through the same portal, declaring its place of establishment, business activities, estimated taxable turnover, and Omani bank account; registration is mandatory once annual taxable supplies exceed the statutory threshold, but VAT registration can be completed ahead of the threshold to secure input tax recovery. The OTA will issue a unified VAT/TIN registration certificate completing the process. A tax law representative may be mandatory if the company has no place of management in Oman.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. An SPC is automatically taxed as a separate juridical entity for Corporate Income Tax (CIT) under Oman Income Tax Law. No pass-through election is available for an LLC-style SPC. However, upon satisfying the Economic Substance Regulations and substance requirements, the company may elect to apply tax treaty relief under Oman's double tax treaties, and may make certain elections regarding depreciable asset pooling, group relief (where applicable under the tax group regime), and VAT grouping under the Oman VAT Law when a related entity satisfies control and financial integration tests. Hybrid mismatch arrangements must be disclosed and adjusted in line with OECD BEPS recommendations; Oman does not recognise hybrid entity passthrough for local law purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 mandatory annual taxable supplies threshold; OMR 19,250 voluntary registration threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman has introduced an electronic invoicing framework under Oman Tax Authority digital compliance. The e-invoicing system is being rolled out in phases. Taxable persons must issue VAT-compliant tax invoices using approved secure electronic means once OTA mandates e-invoicing for their segment. Until full real-time clearance is compulsory, the Oman Tax Authority requires an XML or PDF/A-3 e-invoice to be generated with a unique QR code (base64 data matrix) containing the seller details, VAT registration number, invoice date, taxable amount, and VAT amount. Fiscal clearance is not yet a universal real-time stamping requirement; however, integrated ERP/API reporting via the Taxoman portal is mandatory for VAT return filing, and large taxpayers must operate real-time or near-real-time digital data transmission of VAT invoices and credit notes through OTA-endorsed service providers. OTA may approve Electronic Billing Service Providers (EBSPs) for invoice clearance. Non-compliance attracts administrative penalties under Royal Decree No. 57/2021 (Tax Procedures Law) and VAT penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for (i) the export of goods to a destination outside Oman and outside the GCC VAT territory, provided the export is documented within 90 days of the supply date and goods physically leave Oman without further processing; (ii) transportation of goods and passengers in respect of international travel; (iii) certain offshore services supplied directly to a non-resident person for use outside Oman, including intermediary factoring services linked to cross-border trade finance where the service is supplied to a recipient not present in Oman at the time of supply and the effective use and enjoyment occurs outside Oman; (iv) supplies to a qualifying international organisation; and (v) supplies subject to GCC VAT zero-rating rules. For a factoring SPC, zero-rating of cross-border factoring services is permissible where the service constitutes the assignment of receivables from a non-resident exporter/importer, the invoice specifies the non-resident recipient, and evidence of dispatch or transfer outside Oman is retained. Portion of any local-only service remains taxable at 5%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document / Bayan, as accepted by Oman Customs)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / Transport Evidence
Inward Remittance Certificate (evidence of foreign exchange repatriation)
Proof of the export or import destination outside Oman
Certificate of Origin (where required by OTA)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is rigorously audited by the Oman Tax Authority (OTA). Overstating zero-rated export turnover, falsifying export documentation, or failing to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days triggers retrospective clawback of the zero-rated VAT benefit, with tax assessed at 5% plus interest. Under Royal Decree No. 57/2021 on Tax Procedures and the Oman VAT Law (Royal Decree No. 121/2020), tax evasion penalties include administrative fines up to 100% of the understated tax, imprisonment up to 5 years, and fines up to OMR 100,000. Additional penalties apply for incorrect records, failure to submit documentation (OMR 1,500 to 10,000), and late payment or late filing. The OTA may also freeze bank accounts and impose a travel ban on responsible officers where evasion is suspected. In the factoring context, any bank or SWIFT remittance supporting a factored debt must match the underlying trade transaction; anomalous or synthetic manufacturing of trade flows exposes the taxpayer to anti-avoidance reviews and criminal referral.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) – Foreign Exchange Administration
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is pegged to the U.S. dollar at a fixed rate of 1 OMR = 2.60028 USD. Current account transactions are freely convertible upon presentation of a legitimate underlying trade or service contract. Capital account transactions, including investment transfers, loans, and portfolio flows, are generally liberal for foreign-owned entities but may require CBO registration or prior notification for large amounts, particularly for external debt and direct investments. Profit remittance by a foreign-owned SPC is permitted without exchange control approval provided the entity has submitted its audited financial statements to the Oman Tax Authority and obtained a tax clearance certificate. Practical hurdles include the requirement to use a licensed Omani commercial bank as an Authorised Dealer, compliance with anti-money laundering documentation, and submission of BoP purpose codes for every inbound and outbound wire.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose a mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. Exporters must repatriate the full value of export receipts to an Omani licensed bank within 180 days from the date of shipment or invoice, whichever is earlier. Export proceeds may be retained in a foreign currency export account or converted into OMR at the bank's buying rate. Each repatriation must be accompanied by the customs export declaration, commercial invoice, bill of lading, and an exporter's written declaration. The CBO requires banks to report any overdue export proceeds exceeding 180 days. Exemptions are available for projects operating within Free Zones or Special Economic Zones only with a specific CBO circular.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low. Offshore digital EMIs (Electronic Money Institutions) are not licensed by the Central Bank of Oman and cannot be used as a primary treasury or settlement rail for a licensed factoring SPC. Such EMIs may only provide ancillary payment initiation services, but all inward capital injections, factoring disbursements, and intercompany cash flows must pass through a CBO-licensed commercial bank. Legal constraints include absence of CBO clean regulatory standing, inability to obtain Omani Rial IBANs, and AML/CFT blockages for non-bank financial intermediaries. Any use of an offshore EMI exposes the entity to enhanced scrutiny and reputational risk with the Omani commercial banking sector.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC), the sole shareholder and at least one director or duly authorised signatory must appear physically at the Omani bank's branch for the final account-opening interview. Remote video-KYC is not accepted as a standalone mechanism; a notarised and attested power of attorney is required for any non-present signatory. For the capital escrow account, the physical presence of the beneficial owner is mandatory to satisfy CBO's beneficial ownership identification rules. Some tier-1 banks will allow a preliminary online submission of the onboarding package, but the physical interview is non-waivable unless the shareholder is an established customer of that bank for more than 12 months.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk COP or beneficial ownership opacity due to non-resident corporate shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation of all entities in the ownership chain; memorandum and articles of association; UAE/Oman commercial registration if applicable; board resolution in favour of the SPC; declaration of ultimate beneficial owner form signed by all directors; signed organisational chart; notarised and attested copies of passports; and a bank reference letter from the shareholder's home bank stating relationship length and account conduct.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Factoring transaction documentation lacking clear title or underlying receivable assignment
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master reverse factoring agreement; original assignment notice addressed to the debtor; copy of each underlying commercial invoice to be factored; signed purchase order and delivery proof (bill of lading, customs release, or signed POD); the debtor's acknowledgment of the invoice and assignment; and the entity's factoring ledger/reconciliation report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Political exposure, unusual source of funds, or negative sanctions screening result
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Clean criminal record certificate from the shareholding jurisdiction; sanctions screening report from a recognised checker (e.g., OFAC, EU, UN) dated within 90 days; detailed source of wealth statement detailing funds for the capital injection; certified audited financial statements or proof of liquidity; and a clearance or non-objection letter from the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the SPC's capital escrow account maintained at a CBO-licensed commercial bank. The wire instruction must include the beneficiary IBAN, the purpose code for 'Investment of Non-Resident in Oman' (e.g., BoP code 2003) and a free-text narrative referencing the Commercial Registration number and the share capital deposit advice. The receiving bank will verify the underlying foreign investment documentation, including the certified memorandum, the capital constitution document, and the bank's internal foreign investment registration form. For amounts exceeding OMR 5 million, the receiving bank must notify the CBO's Balance of Payments division before final crediting. The funds must remain in the escrow account until the required capital verification certificate is issued by the bank and the Oman Tax Authority acknowledges the capital registration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for factoring settlements are effected through SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier or debtor payments; for larger supply-chain finance programmes, documentary Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) may be used from the SPC's sponsoring bank. Every outward MT103 must carry the underlying invoice reference, the factoring contract identifier, and the correct balance-of-payments purpose code for trade credit repayment. Payments above OMR 25,000 require the submission of the principal factoring agreement and a lot-by-lot invoice schedule to the bank's trade finance unit. The CBO mandates that all outward foreign exchange settlements be reported in the bank's daily transaction reporting platform within 24 hours. For debtor collections from cross-border buyers, the entity must send a bank collection instruction together with an assignment notice and the original invoice to the brand? no, to the bank, and the clearing proceeds are credited to the operational account after receipt of final payment from the overseas debtor.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright foreign exchange forwards with a firm underlying trade or factoring exposure
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies without active OMR liquidity
Cross-currency swaps for long-term asset-liability mismatch
Plain-vanilla foreign exchange options limited to hedging genuine exposure
FX rollovers and forward extensions on the same underlying trade transaction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) / Invest Easy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the CR certificate expiry date (anniversary of issue); administrative grace period not to exceed 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers fines payable to MCIIP; failure to renew beyond the grace period causes suspension of commercial registration and final administrative strike-off of the SPC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) – Companies Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the statutory period prescribed by the Oman Commercial Companies Law (generally not later than six months after the financial year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing subjects the SPC to monetary penalties under the Commercial Companies Law; continuing default may result in suspension of commercial registration, strike-off proceedings, and personal liability of the directors for unpaid penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return filing with audited accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the period specified by the Oman Income Tax Law (commonly within six months after the end of the tax year adopted by the SPC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties plus monthly late-payment interest on unpaid tax; persistent non-compliance may trigger OTA default assessment, enforced collection, and denial of the annual tax clearance certificate.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Oman limited liability companies, including single-person companies (SPCs), must appoint a licensed auditor and prepare audited financial statements each year irrespective of revenue, assets, or number of employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); SMEs may apply IFRS for SMEs where permitted by Omani law.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: On every share transfer or beneficial-ownership change, the SPC must update the Register of Beneficial Owners within 30 days and notify the Commercial Registrar. A no-change annual confirmation or renewed UBO declaration is filed together with the annual CR renewal, verifying that the recorded members and ultimate beneficial owners are complete and accurate.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 300–750 USD (annual local registered agent / registered office services in Muscat)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 2,500–4,500 USD (Omani licensed audit firm fee for a trade-finance factoring SPC)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The first OMR 30,000 of taxable income is exempt under the Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009 as amended by Royal Decree 9/2020), producing a 0% effective rate on that tranche. No sector-specific tax holiday applies to a trade supply-chain factoring SPC. Deductions are available for expenses wholly and exclusively incurred for the business, statutory tax depreciation, and evidenced specific bad debts arising from purchased receivables; general provisions are non-deductible.
